# hiok_stream_destination (Resource)

A platform a live stream is repeated to — YouTube, Facebook, an SRT receiver.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `streaming_endpoint_id` (String) The stream to repeat.
- `target_url` (String) The platform's ingest URL.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `mode` (String) copy repeats the published bitstream; transcode re-encodes for this destination.
- `platform` (String) youtube, facebook, instagram, twitch, boxcast, linkedin, x, kick, rtmp or srt.
- `resolution` (String)
- `stream_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `video_bitrate` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
